title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese on Carrying Out Pilot Work on Diversified Resolution of Disputes Involving Overseas Chinese in Certain Regions
keywords_en: Carrying out overseas Chinese-related dispute resolution in selected regions
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court  All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese

Opinions on Carrying Out Pilot Work on Diversified Resolution of Disputes Involving Overseas Chinese in Certain Regions

Fa [2018] No. 69

To the High People's Courts and Federations of Returned Overseas Chinese of the following provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government): Jilin, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian, Hunan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, and Yunnan:

To implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, strengthen the construction of mechanisms for preventing and resolving social conflicts, promote the diversified resolution of disputes in the field of overseas Chinese affairs, build a social governance pattern of joint contribution, joint governance, and shared benefits, and lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and their family members as well as overseas Chinese nationals, in accordance with the People's Mediation Law of the People's Republic of China, the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of the Rights and Interests of Returned Overseas Chinese and Their Family Members, the Opinions on Improving the Diversified Resolution Mechanism for Conflicts and Disputes (Zhongban Fa [2015] No. 60) issued by the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the General Office of the State Council, and the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Further Deepening the Reform of the Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism by People's Courts (Fa Fa [2016] No. 14), the Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese have decided to carry out pilot work on diversified resolution of disputes involving overseas Chinese in 11 provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government): Jilin, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian, Hunan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, and Yunnan. The following opinions are hereby put forward.

1. Significance of the pilot work. Returned overseas Chinese and their family members, as well as overseas Chinese nationals, are an important force in building socialism with Chinese characteristics, promoting the peaceful reunification of the motherland, and realizing the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Carrying out pilot work on diversified resolution of disputes involving overseas Chinese is of great significance for protecting the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas Chinese and their family members and the lawful rights and interests of overseas Chinese nationals, for supporting the construction of the Belt and Road Initiative, for participating in the formulation of international rules, and for enhancing the international discourse power in dispute resolution. It is conducive to promoting and improving a diversified dispute resolution system with Chinese characteristics.

2. General requirements for the pilot work. The High People's Courts and the provincial-level Federations of Returned Overseas Chinese in the pilot provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government) shall jointly study and formulate pilot work plans, and report them to the Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese for filing. People's courts at all levels shall effectively strengthen the adjudication of cases involving overseas Chinese, and play an important role in leading, promoting, and safeguarding the construction of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism for overseas Chinese affairs. Organizations of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese at all levels shall take the initiative, actively participate in dispute resolution work, strengthen their own capacity building, enhance work innovation, and promote pilot projects in areas where returned overseas Chinese and their family members are relatively concentrated and in traditional overseas Chinese hometowns. People's courts and Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese organizations in the pilot areas shall strengthen work contacts, promptly study and resolve problems encountered in the reform, carry out work creatively, and ensure that the reform direction is correct, steps are coordinated, and results are achieved.

3. Improve mediation organizations. Organizations of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese at all levels shall widely absorb returned overseas Chinese and their family members, as well as various types of professionals, into people's mediation organizations. Where conditions permit, efforts may be made to explore the establishment of mediation centers for disputes involving overseas Chinese with the nature of private non-enterprise units. Relying on existing mediation organizations, court specially invited mediation organizations, and litigation-mediation liaison centers, etc., returned overseas Chinese and their family members and various professionals shall be recruited as mediators. Mediation organizations for overseas Chinese affairs may provide mediation services in areas such as marriage and family, neighborly relations, small-amount debts, labor disputes, property rights disputes, project contracting, investment, finance, intellectual property, and international trade. Mediation organizations for overseas Chinese affairs shall focus on improving the mediation confidentiality system, summarizing and promoting successful mediation experience, cultivating professional mediation talents, and actively conducting exchanges with extraterritorial mediation organizations.

4. Engage lawyers to participate. Organizations of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese at all levels shall strengthen communication and liaison with judicial administrative organs and lawyers' associations, and innovate models of cooperation between lawyers and Federation organizations. Give full play to the role of the legal advisory committee of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, and explore the establishment of exchange and cooperation mechanisms with overseas lawyer teams. Lawyers may be stationed in or lawyer studios may be established within mediation organizations for overseas Chinese affairs, and mediators may be stationed in lawyer mediation studios and lawyer mediation centers. Fully mobilize the enthusiasm of lawyers to participate in the resolution of disputes involving overseas Chinese, leverage the specialized and professional advantages of lawyers, and provide diversified and comprehensive legal services for returned overseas Chinese and their family members and overseas Chinese nationals.

5. Encourage horizontal cooperation. Organizations of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese at all levels and mediation organizations for overseas Chinese affairs shall establish and improve work liaison mechanisms with people's mediation organizations, commercial mediation organizations, industry mediation organizations, arbitration institutions, notarization institutions, etc. Strengthen cooperation with higher education institutions and scientific research institutions, leverage respective advantages and provide mutual support in personnel training, business expansion, work coordination, etc., serving major national development strategies such as the innovation-driven development strategy, the rural revitalization strategy, the regional coordinated development strategy, and the Belt and Road Initiative.

6. Enhance the application of science and technology. Organizations of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese at all levels shall actively apply modern technologies such as mobile internet and artificial intelligence to facilitate the participation of returned overseas Chinese and their family members and overseas Chinese nationals in dispute resolution. Organizations of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese at all levels and mediation organizations for overseas Chinese affairs shall actively develop and apply information systems, establish online dispute resolution platforms, and encourage and guide parties and mediators to resolve disputes online. Actively explore establishing linkages with relevant information systems of people's courts, and lawfully promote the orderly connection of materials such as evidence, points of dispute, mediation reasons, and undisputed facts formed during the mediation process with litigation procedures, effectively reducing the litigation burden on parties and resolving disputes fairly and efficiently.

7. Implement judicial functions. People's courts in pilot areas shall regard handling cases and enforcing the law as their primary task, continuously improve the quality and efficiency of adjudication, and effectively play the role of the judiciary in settling disputes and maintaining social fairness and justice. Basic-level people's courts in pilot areas shall, in accordance with the law, strengthen business guidance to people's mediation organizations, and continuously enhance the ability of people's mediation organizations to prevent and resolve social conflicts and disputes. People's courts and Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese organizations in pilot areas shall, in accordance with the requirements of the pilot reform of people's jurors, actively recommend and designate qualified returned overseas Chinese and their family members to serve as people's jurors and participate in the adjudication of cases involving overseas Chinese. In farms, enterprises, and townships where returned overseas Chinese and their family members are relatively concentrated, people's courts may facilitate litigation for the public by setting up circuit case handling points, rights protection bases, etc.

8. Strengthen judicial guarantees. People's courts in pilot areas shall strengthen communication and coordination with Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese organizations, guide parties to give priority to non-litigation methods for resolving disputes involving overseas Chinese, and encourage parties to promptly perform mediation agreements. People's courts shall improve the litigation-mediation liaison mechanism for cases involving overseas Chinese, and actively include Federation mediation organizations and mediators in the roster of specially invited mediation organizations and mediators of the people's courts. For disputes or cases involving overseas Chinese that are brought to the people's courts and are suitable for mediation, the people's courts may, through referral or delegation of mediation, have the mediation organizations for overseas Chinese affairs and mediators conduct mediation first. Where an agreement is reached through mediation referred or delegated by the people's court or conducted by a mediation organization for overseas Chinese affairs, and the parties apply for judicial confirmation, the people's court shall confirm the validity of the mediation agreement in accordance with the law. People's courts shall, in accordance with the law, improve the adjudication work mechanism for cases involving overseas Chinese, improve information sharing platforms, and increase the efficiency of preventing and resolving disputes; support Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese organizations in participating in pre-litigation and in-litigation dispute resolution work in accordance with the law, and guide parties to express their claims rationally and safeguard their lawful rights and interests.

9. Strengthen personnel training. People's courts and Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese organizations at all levels shall strengthen the training of mediators and people's jurors, improve the pre-service training and on-the-job learning mechanisms for mediators and people's jurors, strengthen professional ethics, and enhance mediation skills and legal literacy. Compile excellent training materials, innovate training methods, and continuously raise the professional and specialized level of the mediator team.

10. Improve funding guarantees. People's courts and Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese organizations in pilot areas shall firmly rely on the leadership of Party committees, actively seek government support, coordinate and promote financial departments to include funds for resolving disputes involving overseas Chinese in the government fiscal budget, promote government procurement of services, and refine the "case-based subsidy" and various assessment and incentive mechanisms. Organizations of the Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese at all levels shall explore the establishment of funds for resolving conflicts and disputes involving overseas Chinese, encourage returned overseas Chinese and their family members, overseas Chinese nationals, and relevant units to provide special donations or special funding for dispute resolution, and standardize the management and use of donated assets. Mediation organizations for overseas Chinese affairs that have the conditions may operate in a market-oriented manner, providing dispute resolution services according to the needs of the parties and charging appropriate fees. People's courts shall strengthen judicial assistance work, leverage the leverage effect of litigation costs, and punish illegal acts such as abuse of litigation rights and false litigation in accordance with the law.

11. Strengthen publicity and guidance. People's courts and Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese organizations at all levels shall make full use of various media means to publicize the advantages of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism. Integrate the patriotic and collectivist spirit of overseas Chinese with traditional Chinese dispute resolution concepts, guide the majority of returned overseas Chinese and their family members and overseas Chinese nationals to strengthen self-management and independently resolve disputes, and continuously promote the role of Chinese judicial culture in improving the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics.

12. Improve local legislation. People's courts and Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese organizations in pilot areas shall promptly summarize the mature experience gained from local pilot work, actively promote the enactment of relevant local regulations and rules in their regions; for regions where corresponding local regulations and rules have already been enacted, efforts shall be made to improve and implement supporting mechanisms, institutionalize and legalize the pilot results, and ensure that the pilot work proceeds in an orderly and smooth manner in accordance with the law.

13. Strengthen organizational leadership. The High People's Courts and Federations of Returned Overseas Chinese in the pilot provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government) shall strengthen the organization, supervision, and guidance of the pilot work. People's courts and Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese organizations in pilot areas shall seriously study new situations and new problems, promptly summarize pilot experience, provide feedback on the pilot situation, and report the progress of the pilot work, problems encountered, and work suggestions level by level to the Supreme People's Court and the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese.

March 8, 2018
